action.closeOpen: Close the open dialog, menu, picker or tooltip
action.moveList: Move through a menu or list of options
action.jumpFont: Jump to the first or last font
action.copy: Copy the selected marker, zone, text or line
action.stepBack: Step back: deselect, disarm the tool, then close the panel
action.toggleSelection: Add to or remove from the selection
action.pan: Pan the map, even while drawing
action.moveLegend: Move the legend or scale bar (Shift: ×5)
action.finishLine: Finish the line, route or polygon
action.finishRoute: Finish the route, measurement or area polygon
action.clearPoints: Clear the points, or stop drawing
action.snap45: Snap to 45° (lines, routes, measure) or draw a square / keep proportions (zones)
action.nextCell: Next / previous cell (Tab in the last cell adds a row)
action.resizeCell: Resize a column or row (drag its border)
action.resetRow: Reset a row to automatic height
action.openMention: Open a mention in a new tab
action.copyToFolder: Add an article to another folder and keep it in this one (plain drag moves it)
action.moveItem: Move an item up or down
action.setClock: Set a progress clock to the focused segment
action.boxSelect: Select the cards in a box
action.boardMenu: Open the menu of the selection or a group
action.openGroup: Open a group to edit its cards
action.writeOnBoard: Write in a note or an arrow's label
action.drawArrow: Draw an arrow to another card
